title: THIR builder creates CallInst, not MethodCallInst — MIR dispatch works differently
content: The THIR MIR builder (thir_mir_builder.cpp:791) creates CallInst directly for method calls, NOT MethodCallInst. The devirtualization pass can also convert MethodCallInst → CallInst. This means emit_method_call_inst in instructions_method.cpp is RARELY reached. All method dispatch fixes for the MIR path must go in emit_call_inst in instructions.cpp. The value_types_ map tracks LLVM types per MIR value ID across instructions. This is the most common gotcha when debugging MIR codegen — looking in the wrong dispatch function.
